verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a REST API, TypeScript SDK and CLI alongside the dashboard, and says agents can be launched through any of them. A live OpenAPI spec and API-key role assignment show the API is first-class. However, no evidence states or demonstrates full UI parity, and some configuration (custom model endpoints) is described only in the dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a documented mapping of dashboard features (e.g., model provider setup, access management) to API endpoints, and hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Launch your first agent with Omnara via the dashboard, or programmatically with the CLI, the REST API, or the TypeScript SDK.
Omnara provides an **API**, **Typescript SDK**, and **CLI** to interact with Omnara
Assign organization and project roles to users and API keys.
